identityReviewRetry.observedSource: Native Svelulan has clusters of small acne/pockmarked texture on the forehead and upper cheeks, short central parted top with shaved sides, muted green eyes and long gathered beard.
identityReviewRetry.observedResult: Photograph preserves beard and shaved sides but replaces blemished skin with relatively smooth skin plus wrinkles; top is raised back into a quiff and eyes look grey.
identityReviewRetry.correction: Restore visible natural SMALL ACNE/PIT texture clusters across forehead and upper cheeks, as in the native source; closed mild blemishes and pock texture, not scars, wounds or dramatic disease. Preserve mature 44-year-old skin but do not substitute ordinary wrinkles for this distinguishing texture. Keep irises muted green-grey with green visible.
